# gymtracker

> A nutrition tracker and workout planner that runs in the visitor's browser.
> Food entries, body weight readings, daily targets and workout programs are
> stored in IndexedDB. There is no account, server-side personal-data storage or
> analytics. The only third-party request is an optional barcode lookup against
> Open Food Facts.

## Pages

- [gymtracker](https://gymtracker.kucera.uk/): what the application is and how it works.
- [Privacy](https://gymtracker.kucera.uk/privacy): what is stored, where it is stored, and the single thing that leaves the device.
- [Machines](https://gymtracker.kucera.uk/machines): the confirmed machine catalogue and approximate muscle emphasis.

## Notes

- The personal application screens at /log, /programs, /history and /settings render no meaningful
  content without the visitor's own local database, so they are marked noindex
  and are not listed here.
- Source code: https://github.com/duvvy8/gymtracker
